trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 trophies are yours. There is no separate task: work the roadmap in order — story, strangers, activities, collectibles, crime and money — and finish with 100% completion, which is the last big gate before this one.
trophies.missableNote: Cannot be missed. It is the reward for everything else, so it can only be delayed, never locked out.

trophies.missableNote: Cannot be missed. Story mission, no alternate path.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion on the in-game checklist. In GTA games this means finishing the story, all stranger missions, all activities, collectibles and side content the checklist counts — the game's own stats screen shows what is still missing, so check it after the story and work down the list. This is the hardest trophy and the main reason the platinum is estimated at around 200 hours; leave it for last and let the other trophies feed it.
trophies.missableNote: Cannot be missed — 100% completion is all post-game clean-up — but it is the longest grind, so track the in-game checklist rather than guessing.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts in total — jumps, near misses, airtime and other driving feats the game counts as stunts. They accumulate across the whole playthrough, so you will build a large total just by driving aggressively; for the remainder, find a good jump spot and repeat it. The game's stats screen tracks the running count, so check it before grinding.
trophies.missableNote: Cannot be missed. Stunts count cumulatively and there is no time limit.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try every type of side activity at least once — fishing, races, the shooting range, arcade games, bowling, meditation, drone races and the other activities the game offers. You only need one attempt at each, not a win, so open each activity once and the trophy pops when the last type is sampled. The activity list in this guide's Activities filter shows the rest of the activity trophies, which map to the types.
trophies.missableNote: Cannot be missed. Activities stay open after the story, and one attempt each is enough.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Visit a shooting range (ammunition store ranges), pick a challenge and beat its gold score or time. Work through the weapon categories one at a time; gold on an early challenge teaches the scoring, then repeat the pattern. If a challenge resists, come back with a better weapon or more practice — the ranges never close.
trophies.missableNote: Cannot be missed. All 42 challenges stay available after the story.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Andy's stranger mission strand. Stranger strands are chains of side missions for one character: meet Andy, do each mission he offers in turn, and the trophy pops when his last one ends. Stranger missions appear as question-mark or character icons on the map; if Andy is not showing, advance the story until his strand opens.
trophies.missableNote: Cannot be missed, as far as the official description shows — but stranger strands can be easy to overlook, so start Andy's chain as soon as it appears rather than leaving it for the end.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every meditation spot across Leonida. Meditation spots are scenic points you visit and sit at; work through them as you explore, and use the map to find each one. Do this during the story, not after it: community guides (PowerPyx, GTABase, reported by EGamers and GTAScoop) flag this as the only trophy that might be missable, because one meditation spot is at Jason's house in Chapter 1 and may become unavailable later. Start meditating in Chapter 1 and clear every spot you find as you go.
trophies.missableNote: POSSIBLY MISSABLE — the only trophy any guide flags. PowerPyx and GTABase flag it (via EGamers / GTAScoop): a meditation spot at Jason's house in Chapter 1 may be lost after that chapter. Meditate at every spot the moment you can, and do not leave this for the post-game.

trophies.name: Don’t Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 full collectible card sets. Cards are scattered across Leonida — in shops, in the world and as rewards — and sets complete when every card of a set is found. Collect as you travel rather than in one sweep, keep the collection screen open to see which sets are close, and finish any 3 sets; you do not need every card in the game.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK feature at 100 different locations. WAiNK is the game's location check-in style feature; each new location you WAiNK at counts once, so the task is really to visit 100 distinct spots and check in at each. Fold it into exploration: WAiNK everywhere you stop, and the total climbs without a dedicated grind.
trophies.missableNote: Cannot be missed. Locations stay open after the story and each counts once.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges in total. Challenges are the game's small feats — the same family as stunts, races and combat feats — and they stack across categories, so the count grows while you chase other trophies. The game tracks 80 challenges in all (per GTAScoop), so you need 50 of the 80; pick the easy ones first and let the rest come naturally.
trophies.missableNote: Cannot be missed. Challenges count cumulatively and stay open after the story.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner (Lucia or Jason, depending on who you play), build a 4-star wanted level and then lose it and escape. Get the cops to 4 stars — a crime spree in a busy area does it — then break line of sight, hide or outrun the search until the wanted level clears. Do it with your partner beside you; solo escapes do not count.
trophies.missableNote: Cannot be missed. Wanted levels can be raised and lost any time in free roam.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops one after another without losing your wanted level — the trick is the opposite of the usual escape: keep the heat on. Rob the first shop, move straight to the next while the wanted level is still active, and repeat a third time before it clears. Plan a route of three close shops in advance so there is no dead time between robberies.
trophies.missableNote: Cannot be missed. Shop robberies can be retried in free roam; a failed run just means starting the chain again.

A vehicle counts when you first find and enter it, so variety is the goal: drive everything — cars, bikes, trucks, boats and aircraft — and check the collection screen for gaps. Rare vehicles are the bottleneck, so note where unusual ones spawn and go back for them.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies during one single use of Combat Focus — the game's slow-motion aiming mode. Wait for a group of 5 or more enemies, trigger Combat Focus, and drop five before it ends. A gang hideout or a shootout with clustered enemies is the right spot; do not waste it on two or three stragglers.
trophies.missableNote: Cannot be missed. Combat Focus can be used any time and the attempt can be retried.

trophies.guide: The description ("Choices made (for better or worse)") points to a story choice: make a significant decision at a branching point in the story and see it through. If the game has more than one such choice, the first one may be the trigger — the method is not confirmed in the game yet.
trophies.missableNote: Cannot be missed, as far as the official description shows — but if the trigger is a single story choice, make sure to engage with choice prompts rather than rushing past them. Method unconfirmed.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock people over with a melee drive-by — attack from a moving vehicle with a melee weapon and bowl them over. Get a vehicle up to speed near a group on foot, swing the melee weapon as you pass, and keep it going until the count registers. A slow drive-by on a quiet street gives you the aim time a fast one does not.
trophies.missableNote: Cannot be missed. Melee drive-bys can be done any time in free roam.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 by laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies and heists; take them to a contact who cleans them and bank the clean cash. The total is cumulative across the whole playthrough, so keep laundering every batch instead of sitting on dirty money, and the $250,000 arrives while you chase the crime trophies.
trophies.missableNote: Cannot be missed. Marked Bills keep coming from crime, and contacts stay available after the story.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops in total. The spend is cumulative and counts every shop type — weapons, clothes, food, vehicles and more — so just play normally and buy what you need; if you are short at the end, bulk-buy expensive items (ammunition and vehicles count). Check the stats screen for the running total before a spending spree.
trophies.missableNote: Cannot be missed. Shops stay open after the story and spending is cumulative.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy every garage property in the game. Garage properties are the purchasable garages that store your vehicles; visit each one on the map and buy it. Save up before the sweep — properties are the expensive part — and buy them in a cluster by region so none is missed.
trophies.missableNote: Cannot be missed. Garage properties stay purchasable after the story.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The app is the in-game delivery-style service: open it, register a vehicle you own or have found, and repeat until 10 are on the books. Any 10 vehicles count, so register the first ten you drive and the trophy pops early.
trophies.missableNote: Cannot be missed. Vehicles and the app stay available after the story.
